text: Kingsmoor FC's goal at 82 minutes exemplified effective pressing and transition under coach Pablo Iriarte. Luca Iversen's high turnover winning tackle near their own half triggered a rapid counterattack with just two passes over 9 seconds, including a progressive long ball to Mason Morales, who delivered a wide cross aligning with their crossing style. This swift and coordinated buildup exploited Westport Albion's less aggressive pressing, enabling Iversen to finish from close range and level the score at 3-3 [#1512] [#1513] [#1514] [#1516]. A key coaching point is to continue emphasizing aggressive ball recovery and immediate forward transitions to leverage these high turnovers effectively.
